Scientific Rationale
Badminton is dominated by rapid changes of direction; change-of-direction tests quantify how efficiently an athlete decelerates and reaccelerates around the court.
Why This Test Exists
Hexagon Test contributes agility and coordination to the battery, a quality the sport demands.
Why It Was Selected
Selected as a standardized, equipment-appropriate way to measure agility and coordination at this level.

Reliability
Illustrative: timed change-of-direction courses are generally reliable when the path and start are standardized.
Validity
Illustrative: good construct validity for planned agility; reactive variants add a decision component.

About

Develop. Compete. Belong.

Built around the next step.

ChampionSpace brings a development mindset to badminton: understand what is happening, decide what to work on and return to the evidence.

A score is a starting point.

An assessment is useful when it changes the next coaching conversation. A training plan matters when it reaches the court. Progress becomes clearer when the athlete returns for a comparable review.

ChampionSpace is being developed around those connections, with an academy platform for athlete development and a separate Tournament Space for event operations.

Our approach

Make the evidence understandable.
Context before conclusions

Show what a result means, which reference it uses and where evidence is limited.

People before dashboards

Give athletes, coaches, academies and families a view that helps them take the next step.

Progress over time

Connect plans, participation and reassessment rather than treating one measurement as the full story.

About this website

Your enquiry stays in your hands.

Understand what happens when you explore the site or prepare an enquiry.

Enquiry details

The enquiry form prepares text in your browser. It does not submit your answers to a server or save them to browser storage. The form is kept in page memory only.

Email and copying

“Open email draft” passes the recipient, subject and enquiry text to your configured email application. You decide whether to send it. “Copy enquiry” copies the text to your clipboard. Your email provider handles any message you send.

Website content and hosting

Images, fonts and demonstrations are served as website assets. This implementation does not include advertising trackers or an analytics service. Hosting and browser services may process ordinary connection information; their operation is separate from the enquiry form.

Athlete records

This public website does not provide access to athlete accounts. Please do not include athlete records or sensitive personal information in an enquiry. Data handling for the operational product must be established as part of onboarding.

About

Develop. Compete. Belong.

Built around the next step.

ChampionSpace brings a development mindset to badminton: understand what is happening, decide what to work on and return to the evidence.

A score is a starting point.

An assessment is useful when it changes the next coaching conversation. A training plan matters when it reaches the court. Progress becomes clearer when the athlete returns for a comparable review.

ChampionSpace is being developed around those connections, with an academy platform for athlete development and a separate Tournament Space for event operations.

Our approach

Make the evidence understandable.
Context before conclusions

Show what a result means, which reference it uses and where evidence is limited.

People before dashboards

Give athletes, coaches, academies and families a view that helps them take the next step.

Progress over time

Connect plans, participation and reassessment rather than treating one measurement as the full story.

About this website

Your enquiry stays in your hands.

Understand what happens when you explore the site or prepare an enquiry.

Enquiry details

The enquiry form prepares text in your browser. It does not submit your answers to a server or save them to browser storage. The form is kept in page memory only.

Email and copying

“Open email draft” passes the recipient, subject and enquiry text to your configured email application. You decide whether to send it. “Copy enquiry” copies the text to your clipboard. Your email provider handles any message you send.

Website content and hosting

Images, fonts and demonstrations are served as website assets. This implementation does not include advertising trackers or an analytics service. Hosting and browser services may process ordinary connection information; their operation is separate from the enquiry form.

Athlete records

This public website does not provide access to athlete accounts. Please do not include athlete records or sensitive personal information in an enquiry. Data handling for the operational product must be established as part of onboarding.
